description:
Xie Lian, the crown prince of Xian Le Kingdom, successfully ascends to Heaven during his third trial in spite of successive demotions. However, he accidentally breaks the Gold Palace of heavenly officials. With no human worshiping him, Xie Lian has to descend to the secular world to exorcise ghosts, which may help him sustain his divinity.

(Source: Funimation)

node.description:
__Height:__ 190 cm - 185 cm (San Lang)

Hua Cheng is the deuteragonist and main love interest in Heaven Official's Blessing.

One of the Four Great Calamities, Hua Cheng is the most famed of the three Devastation-class Demons in the Ghost World, thus he is entitled the Ghost King. When he first emerged, he challenged 33 gods and won, making his name as the scourge of the Heavenly Officials overnight.

~!His most famous moniker, Crimson Rain Sought Flower, was attained during his early days as a supreme. After he annihilated [Qi Rong](https://anilist.co/character/261438/Qi-Rong)'s lair and causing blood rain to fall, he found a lone white flower struggling under the heavy rainfall. Until the downpour ceased, Hua Cheng stood by this flower and shielded it from the rain with his red umbrella.!~

~!Just like any other ghost, Hua Cheng's only weakness is his ashes. Hua Cheng's ashes were modelled into a diamond ring that he entrusted to [Xie Lian](https://anilist.co/character/149589/Xie-Lian). When asked if his ashes were sufficiently protected, he stated that if the hiding place of his ashes were to be destroyed, then he would no longer have any reason to exist and might as well disappear.!~

alternative: His Royal Majesty the Crown Prince (太子殿下)
Flower Crown Martial God (花冠武神)
His Highness Who Pleased the Gods (太子悦神)
State Perceptor Fang Xin (国师芳心剑)

node.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Weapons:__ Ruoye, Fang Xin

Xie Lian is the main protagonist of the Chinese web novel _Heaven Official's Blessing_.

He was widely known throughout the Xian Le nation as the beloved yet strange prince. Never showing interest in what was considered normal for a prince, he simply declared, "I want to save the common people!" Through practice, hard work, and insight beyond his years, he perfected his cultivation and ascended to the Heavens at the age of 17. He owns a special silk band called Ruoye.

After multiple unfortunate events, he was twice banished from the Heavens. 800 years later, he returns for the third time with an immense crash.

alternative: Lord Wind Master Qingxuan (风师青玄)

node.description:
He is one of the Five Elemental Masters in the Heavenly Court. Since he is often worshiped as a female version of himself and often transforms into a woman, he was given the nickname.

He is the younger brother of the Shi Wudu and one of the Four Famous Tales - "The Young Lord Who Pours Wine" (少君倾酒).

Mu Qing is a supporting character in Heaven Official's Blessing.

Mu Qing is a Martial God who oversees the southwest. Eight hundred years ago, he was the personal attendant of Xie Lian. He abandoned the Prince to take care of his mother when Xie Lian descended from Heaven for the first time.

Feng Xin is a supporting character in Heaven Official's Blessing. 

Feng Xin is a Martial God who oversees the southeast. Eight hundred years ago, he was the imperial bodyguard of Xie Lian and later, the first general of the Crown Prince's Palace Hall.
Lingwen is the foremost Civil Goddess in the Heavenly Court and one of the notorious Three Tumors.

__Height:__ 189 cm

He Xuan is a ghost of Supreme rank and one of the Four Great Calamities. He bears the title Black Water Submerging Boats and his domain is the Black Water Demon Lair.
Yi Ming is one of the Five Elemental Masters in the Heavenly Court.

Qi Rong is a Savage level ghost who is close to becoming a Supreme. Despite not being a ghost of the highest rank, he is still regarded as one of the Four Great Calamities, known as the Night-Touring Green Lantern.

He is the maternal cousin of Xie Lian and bore the title Prince Xiao Jing during his years as Xianle royalty.

(Source: Fandom Wiki)

alternative: The General Who Broke His Sword

node.description: Pei Ming, titled as General Ming Guang, is the Martial God of the North with nine thousand temples dedicated to his palace. He is one of the Four Famous Tales: "The General Who Broke His Sword", as well as a member of The Three Tumors.

She was the Imperial Preceptor of the fallen Banyue kingdom. She was claimed a traitor by its people after allowing the invading army into the city.
~!She had first met Xie Lian over 200 years ago. He took care of her as she was an orphan as a child!~
A Heavenly Official of the Middle Court and subordinate of Mu Qing. He often accompanied Xie Lian on his missions in the mortal realm alongside Nan Feng.
A Heavenly Official of the Middle Court and subordinate of Feng Xin. He often accompanied Xie Lian on his missions in the mortal realm alongside Fu Yao.

Xiu Pei is a Heavenly Official of the Middle Court and subordinate of Ming Pei. He appears in the first arc of the story.
He is a proud and composed young man. He takes his tasks as a Martial God seriously and isn't shown to be very emotional.
He holds deep respect and admiration for Ming Pei and is friendly toward Banyue and Lian Xie.
~!For 150 years before the start of the novel, he lured people into the Banyue Kingdom to be fed to the ghosts of the soldiers as a way to calm their resentment. As a Heavenly Official, with his every move watched, he could not directly kill the remaining ghosts of the soldiers in the Sinner's Pit. Instead, he descended as a traveling guide called A-Zhao and worked to cover up the massacre!~
A powerful female ghost of Savage rank and a former lover of Pei Ming.
White No-Face, titled as the White-Clothed Calamity, is the eldest and most powerful of the Four Great Calamities. Centuries ago, he had great influence in the fall of the Xianle kingdom.
